title: Axiom of union
summary: The members of members of a set can be gathered into one set.

context.note: This node belongs to one explicit foundational presentation; alternate foundations may encode it differently.

assumptions.text: The declared first-order set theory context is fixed.

content.plain: The members of members of a set can be gathered into one set.
content.caveat: Union flattens one membership level; it is not intersection or disjoint union.
